purpose: The Ledger Service is the single source of financial truth for Meridian Pay, recording all financial transactions in a secure, immutable, and auditable manner.

components.name: ledger-core
components.evidence: ledger-core checks that the entry balances, writes it to ledger-db (PostgreSQL) and announces it on ledger-events (Kafka)

components.name: ledger-db
components.evidence: ledger-db (PostgreSQL) is the system of record and holds every entry and every derived balance

components.name: ledger-events
components.evidence: ledger-core announces it on ledger-events (Kafka) so that other teams, for example notifications and analytics, can react in real time

flows.evidence: Wallet and payment services send journal entries to ledger-core
